info.name: EMS API smoke tests
info.description: API smoke checks. Sign in with an authorized manager account; Postman retains the session cookie for following requests. The payroll request recalculates and persists derived salary totals.

exec: pm.test('sign in succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('response identifies the account role', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('role'); });
pm.test('session is authenticated', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('session returns a role', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('role'); });
pm.test('dashboard request succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('dashboard includes attendance totals', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('attendance'); });
pm.test('employee search succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('employee search returns an array', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('attendance request succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('attendance response is an array', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('payroll request succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('payroll response includes the selected month and salaries', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.month).to.eql(pm.variables.get('month')); pm.expect(body.salaries).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('user list is available to the manager', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('user response is an array', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('unlinked employee list is available to the manager', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('unlinked employee response is an array', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('monthly export list is available to the manager', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('export response is an array', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('automatic export setting is available to the manager', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('setting contains a boolean enabled value', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().enabled).to.be.a('boolean'); });
pm.test('sign out clears the session', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
